title: Console Hub provider manifest (apiVersion 1)
description: See PLUGINS.md. The app checks more than this schema can (e.g. that every URL is on one of `domains`).

id.description: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes. The provider's folder is named this once added.

name.description: Shown in the sidebar. One line.

author.description: Shown, unverified, when someone is asked to allow the provider. One line.

url.description: The console opened when the provider is selected.

external.description: Open the console in the default browser instead of the app.

domains.description: Hosts the provider may load pages from and read responses from, each including its subdomains. At least two labels (example.com), no IP addresses.

metrics.description: The balance shown in the sidebar. Leave out for a provider that only opens its console.

key.description: The name of the function in extract.js, e.g. "balance".

page.description: Loaded in the background, signed in, to read the balance.

additionalProperties.description: A JavaScript regular expression matched against the full URL of each JSON response.

captures.description: Capture name -> URL pattern. The function receives each capture's latest matching response body under its name.

required.description: Captures that must arrive before the function runs. All of them if left out.
